high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "thecosmologicalway." The post features a person wearing a NASA spacesuit, with their hand raised as if reaching out or gesturing towards something. The astronaut's helmet has a reflective visor that appears to be displaying a digital glitch effect, adding a futuristic and somewhat abstract element to the image. The text overlay on the image reads: "WE'RE NOWHERE NEAR THE CENTER OF THE GALAXY" in bold yellow letters.
